on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
    - master

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

Updated actions/checkout and actions/setup-node to modern versions (v4) to enable the cache parameter.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
